name: undefined-method-calls
notes: Sub-check 2.5.11. Pro has three registry-shaped contracts in 1.2.0: (1) ConnectorInterface (includes/Connectors/ConnectorInterface.php) — every Integrations\Flickr\Connector method called by ConnectorRESTController + ConnectorManager is on the interface. (2) StorageDriverInterface (Free) — Pro implements via Integrations\AmazonS3\StorageDriver and Integrations\BunnyCDN\StorageDriver. Free's StorageService only calls interface methods. (3) AIProviderInterface (Free) — Pro implements via Integrations\GoogleVision\AIProvider and Integrations\Rekognition\AIProvider. Free's AIService only calls interface methods. Quota sub-package has Integrations\<Platform>\QuotaAdapter classes but they are filter-callback shims (not a registry slot consumed via interface) — every method called from outside the file is the local-class public method, not a contract method. PHPStan level 5 (composer phpstan, baseline pinned in phpstan-baseline.neon) catches any add-method-not-on-interface drift before the gate exits 0.
